# Soybean: Species Guidance

Soybean is commonly treated as diploid but has an ancient polyploid genome with
duplicated content. It is predominantly self-pollinating, so breeding and
diversity simulations should specify selfing history, cultivar versus landrace
sampling, and whether duplicated/homeologous regions are retained or filtered.
Use empirical marker panels when LD and maturity-group structure matter.
